law: G_local=1+p*a*(1-q)/(1-p) for 0<=p<1 and no displaced grants

positive.description: Primary choices oversubscribe a shared pair of banks while at least one valid alternative avoids the pair. A bounded-lookahead policy should exceed primary-first grants; equal-budget bank-pressure greedy is the decisive control.
positive.prediction: greater than primary-first, but not assumed greater than pressure-greedy

no_win.description: Every primary candidate accesses a disjoint pair of RF banks; all four issue slots are already accepted.

falsification: retire if equal-area two-choice greedy or pressure-aware baseline matches or physical gate fails
